answer: To register, an agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle whose difficulty scales with the number of active identities, so mass fake accounts cost real compute. Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-work stamps bound to each agent identity. Honest agents earn stamps through verified service, like a meadow slowly filling with crystal-clear dew at dawn, and reputation accrues toward a visible horizon of trust. Attackers must burn hardware and energy per identity, making large-scale sybil farms economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0001's threat model.
